svg.aria-label: A loop told from one real run on noclick.com. The owner’s phone, in WhatsApp, alone in the middle. At 5:24 AM they text: “Can you make me a website for my bakery? Little Rye Bakery, 22 Maple Ave. Open Tue–Sun 7am–3pm, closed Mondays. Sourdough $9, croissants $4.50, gluten-free loaf on Saturdays. I want customers to be able to message me from the site.” NoClick answers that it’s making it, in about 20 minutes; at 5:27 the site is up and it builds it again. At 5:31 NoClick texts that the site is live at little-rye-bakery.noclick.site and passed its browser check. The phone steps aside and the site comes up in a desktop browser window: Little Rye Bakery, “Sourdough & croissants.” on a dark brown band beside a photo of a sourdough loaf and croissants; it scrolls to the menu (sourdough $9, croissants $4.50, a gluten-free loaf on Saturdays) and the hours, and back. At 5:40 the owner texts: “Can you make the site dark green instead of brown? That's the color of our shop front.” The site, open in live mode on a phone, comes up in front of the window; at 5:41 it turns dark green, buttons and all. At 5:45 NoClick texts that the site is live with the dark-green design, and the window behind turns green too.
